source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: setFolderPropertiesFromFolder applies RSS status datasets before waiting for document load. Only the single-feed page-icon assignment is deferred when readyState is not complete. Existing setServer/setFolder callers do not await the helper, so their return does not promise favicon completion; even the helper's completion means style assignment, not image loading. The source comment records the load-group rationale. No isolated failure or cure was reproduced.
title: RSS row status updates precede the deferred favicon assignment
